title: AGL ERP Systems
summary: A working ERP for Automobiles Ghana Ltd, connecting sales, workshop, HR, administration and finance workflows.
features: Translated operational requirements into system specifications and coordinated implementation.
Replaced disconnected paper and WhatsApp processes with centralized data capture and operational reporting.
Supported staff adoption through training in data capture, reporting, teamwork and workplace ethics.
Production-ready ERP delivered in under 32 weeks during the October 2024–July 2026 role.
alt: AGL ERP public sign-in screen captured on 22 October 2026
note: Public access currently opens a sign-in screen; authenticated workflows were not re-tested in this review. The GHS 1,200 to 2,700 campaign was a 2024 result, not a current ERP metric. Earlier publication-safe dashboard evidence remains in the project document.

title: Blkk Star Legacy Organization
summary: The live parent website for a Ghanaian nonprofit connecting education, culture, commerce and community.
features: Co-developed organizational architecture, requirements and implementation plans.
Established shared brand and product frameworks and coordinated research, design and technical work.
Tracks actions, dependencies and risks across commerce, analytics and food-system prototypes.
alt: Blkk Star Legacy public organization landing page captured on 22 October 2026
note: The parent website is live. Wider operational rollout and commercial validation remain in progress.

title: Blkk Star Hub
summary: A platform in development for structured digital commerce and business operations across African MSMEs.
features: Investigates verified merchant identity, product discovery, traceability and reusable business workflows.
Sector prototypes explore automotive commerce, food systems and tenant analytics.
Research and staged validation guide the platform architecture and rollout.
alt: Blkk Star Hub restricted-access landing page captured on 22 October 2026
note: The site states that core infrastructure is closed to public access by design to protect it; demonstration requests are offered instead. This explains the restriction notice, not independently verified security. The architecture is a design direction; its planned services are not all implemented or commercially validated.

title: HealthFirst Business Analyst Capstone
summary: A coherent simulated hospital-analysis artifact pack covering requirements, stakeholders, scope, processes, data, dashboards and risk.
features: Separate lab documents and workbooks cover the BRD, RTM, stakeholder matrix, scope/WBS, process models and swimlanes.
Includes data cleaning and analysis, an Excel dashboard, risk register/SWOT and risk-matrix mitigation workbooks.
Deliverables are reviewable locally; the project index records three partial labs where local equivalents replaced platform-specific requirements.
note: Simulated certificate work, not paid client employment. No clean independent final acceptance is claimed. Local diagram/dashboard equivalents do not prove Lucidchart, Visio, Cognos or Looker usage. The older 39-slide hospital case uses a separate dataset.

title: Olist Marketing Funnel & E-Commerce Analysis
summary: Python analysis of lead conversion, commerce-linked sellers and seller-to-customer delivery corridors using public Olist data.
features: Preserves one row per marketing lead by aggregating commerce records before joining seller data.
Repository-verified results: 8,000 leads, 842 closed deals, 10.53% conversion, 380 commerce-linked deals and 45.13% commerce-link rate.
Validates 97,811 eligible seller-order records across 412 state corridors; dashboard exports and Looker Studio publication remain pending.
note: Independent, self-directed project inspired by MIT OpenCourseWare materials. No MIT enrollment, credential, submission, endorsement or institutional credit.
